_comment: Igris harness distribution manifest (TD-021). Declares, per agent, the canonical prompt source and the set of harness targets that must be mechanically regenerated from it. Consumed by compile_harnesses.sh and check_harness_drift.sh. Canonical is the SOLE source of truth; every target listed here is a GENERATED artifact - editing a target file directly is a process error.

_schema.name: agent identifier; also the basename of versioned-canonical harness files for content-pipeline agents
_schema.canonical.dir: directory holding the canonical prompt, resolved relative to --project-root
_schema.canonical.glob: filename glob for the canonical prompt; only meaningful when versioned=true
_schema.canonical.file: literal canonical filename; only meaningful when versioned=false
_schema.canonical.versioned: true => adapter resolves the newest match via latest_canonical; false => adapter uses canonical.file verbatim
_schema.targets[].path: output harness path, resolved relative to --project-root
_schema.body_exception: optional; when present the target body intentionally diverges from raw canonical by a documented appendix - drift checks compare against canonical + the named appendix
